dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: A prominent reticulated pattern of interconnected circular and polygonal annuli is visible. A distinct figure-eight shaped double-annulus is located mid-dorsally, showing a sharp gradient transition from dark outer perimeters to lighter interior centers. The posterior region features a dense cluster of smaller, high-contrast 'O' shapes.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low spatial density of solid high-intensity pixel clusters. Isolated white spots are visible along the ventral margin and on the dorsal head region, characterized by sharp boundaries and a lack of internal gradient.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the central figure-eight annulus and the two largest posterior annuli form a scalene triangle. These primary texture clusters follow a curvilinear alignment along the dorsal ridge from the mid-section to the tail.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A short, horizontal high-intensity linear mark is visible on the ventral margin mid-body. Several small, irregular white marks are present on the dorsal head and neck region.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive honeycomb-like reticulation on the posterior dorsal surface where annuli share high-contrast boundaries, creating a continuous mesh-like appearance.
